blocking_defects.defect: Car already in the water at 13.2. No readable shelf, no lift, no separating contact shadow. The swept consequence is never completed in frame.
White water drawn as rows of sharp saw-tooth triangles in a near-straight ruled line, with short static curly squiggles for current. Not solid white water at a lip and no curved V wake.
Carry is about one to 1.5 car lengths. Car exits left at 17.0-17.4 level with the bank slab, not several lengths past the oak crown and slab. No long current streaks pass the car.
Clause 'swept into Salado Creek' is pictured as a slow drift that leaves frame unfinished. The cut to s4 at 17.6 comes before the consequence completes.
